in_marathi.name: Mridani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Love, Delight, Charm
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mridani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mridani is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mridan’, which means ‘to delight’, ‘to charm’. This name is associated with the goddess of love, Saraswati, and symbolizes the joy and love that comes from within. It is believed to bring happiness, joy, and prosperity.
